snippet.title: Zen Nihon GT Senshuken Max Rev. - PS1 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Zen Nihon GT Senshuken Max Rev. - Gameplay

Zen Nihon GT Senshuken Max Rev. is a Japanese exclusive racing game, developed and published by Kaneko in 1997.

0:00 Intro
2:20 Car selection screen
4:27 Track selection screen
5:39 Race 1 - Unisia Jecs Skyline
8:29 Race 2 - STP Taisan Porsche GT2
11:06 Race 3 - Tamura Diablo Jota
14:02 Race 4 - Castrol Tom's Supra
16:23 Race 5 - Advan BP NSX
19:03 Race 6 - JUN Trust Skyline
21:47 Race 7 - FedEx 300ZX-GTS
24:20 Race 8 - Zexel Skyline
27:07 Race 9 - Dark McNail (Secret Car)
29:20 Race 10 - Pace Car (Secret Car)

NOTE: Recorded in the original 4:3 aspect ratio and original game graphics (no filters, shaders etc...)
